title: Egyptian Sausage Kebabs
description: A flavorful and aromatic kebab recipe inspired by Egyptian cuisine, featuring juicy sausage and vegetables.

ingredients.name: Sausage
ingredients.notes: You can use any type of sausage, but Egyptian sausage is a good option

ingredients.name: Onion
ingredients.notes: Cut the onion into large chunks

ingredients.name: Bell Pepper
ingredients.notes: Any color bell pepper works well

ingredients.name: Tomato
ingredients.notes: Cherry tomatoes or large tomatoes both work well

ingredients.name: Garlic
ingredients.notes: Mince the garlic before adding it to the kebabs

ingredients.name: Paprika
ingredients.notes: Use sweet or smoked paprika for added flavor

ingredients.name: Black Pepper
ingredients.notes: Use fresh or pre-ground black pepper

instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat (400°F / 200°C).
In a small bowl, mix together minced garlic and paprika.
Thread the sausage, onion, bell pepper, tomato, and garlic onto skewers.
Brush the kebabs with oil and season with salt and black pepper.
Place the kebabs on the grill and cook for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally.
Check the internal temperature of the sausage to ensure it reaches 160°F (71°C).
Serve the kebabs hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro if desired.
